Dear Sir/Madam, 
Sub: Audio recording of Conference/Earnings call held with the Analysts/ Institutional  
         Investors on 19th October, 2026. 
 
In reference to our letter no. CO:IRD:2026:27:179 dated 14th October, 2026, this is to inform 
that the audio recording of Conference/Earnings call held with the Analysts/Investors on             
19th October, 2026 on unaudited Financial Results of the Bank for the Second quarter and Half 
year ended 30th September, 2026 have been uploaded on our Bank’s website and can be accessed 
through following link: 
https://www.centralbank.bank.in/sites/default/files/2026-
10/Central%20bank%20of%20India%20Q2FY27Audio.mp3or 
https://www.centralbank.bank.in/en/investor-relations   
 
Please take the above on your record. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Central Bank of India
